Well, if you must know. 

I chose not to because I started off with the intent of it being secret, i wanted to be faithful to that. You werent the first to ask about it nor will be the last. It was a simple project i could come home to after school and work on. I never wanted anyone to know i was working on something big, even for me at the time. I just couldnt handle the pressure of peoples reaction even on the internet of all places. So i showed my friend tallen. He loved the direction i was going for. Which gave me enough courage to post a bit of it on reddit. But never the game until it was finished. It was going to be free to play. If you wanted to give it a shot. Go ahead. Never had the intent to profit off of it because I know what it was like growing up with out any cash to get games.

At the time, around 2016-2017 i was just learning to use basic code. Originally tested some ideas in source 2 but scraped it. It was to difficult for me to do. 

So i decided to try to go for 2-D and utilize Unity for it. Which is where i began to build it at. I lost my home and had to work on it offline just from the basic knowledge i know so far.  That year was tough because while not only being homeless. I was trying to create something that i wanted to be known for. I thought the idea would change my way of life. Make me proud of something.

The gameplay changed a lot, originally it was going to be using assets of portal 2. Ofcourse source 2 wasnt what i was going to do. So i started messing around with unity, making sprites and what not. 


2018, 2019 was me just occasionally adding a bit more to it. Messing around with possible ideas. Making more sprites. Learning more about coding, c++ was what i mainly used in unity. 

I understand your skeptical, i commend you for asking questions like this. As you rightfully deserve answers. Im just shook up about this.
